decisions.reason: After pandemic-driven demand the conferencing add-on is cheap to keep, but heavy competition from commoditised collaboration platforms leaves little remaining upside, so there is a real chance it is abandoned.
Optical spectrum on owned fibre fits the high-bandwidth strategy and growing data centre interconnect demand, so the option is worth keeping and possibly expanding.
The self-service number ordering portal supports real-time provisioning of the voice business at low marginal cost, so there is no reason to give up the option.

Carrier pre-selection is a fading legacy service as networks migrate to all-IP, so its value is increasingly unlikely to materialise, but its residual upkeep on existing infrastructure is still low enough to keep it for now.
Direct SIP-type voice connections are core to enterprise voice and benefit from the all-IP migration, so the product remains valuable and cheap to maintain.
